giver: The Arcane Order: librarians and Iron's Priests in every village (the pool), led by Archmage Orrin Vael in Reece's library tower; with Sister Maren, a priest who hunts the undead, and Wren, a runaway apprentice with a habit of borrowing things
feel: A scholar's apprenticeship that grows into a hunt for a lost flame: libraries and ink first, then towers, frozen dens and catacombs, ending with a fire older than any book

quests.title: The Order Calls
quests.summary: A village librarian slips you a note: the Arcane Order is recruiting, and the entrance fee is ten books and a quill. Bring them to Archmage Orrin Vael in Reece.
quests.reward: Magic XP, a guidebook to the schools

quests.title: An Honest Table
quests.summary: Orrin despises guesswork. Build an enchanting table ringed by fifteen bookshelves, where Easy Magic shows every enchantment before you commit, and enchant your first tool.

quests.title: Reroll the Fates
quests.summary: Orrin's test: produce a book with two enchantments he names, using Easy Magic's re-roll and the table's bookshelves, without wasting more than ten levels.
quests.reward: Magic XP, an Unbreaking III book

quests.title: The Priest's Blessing
quests.summary: Sister Maren, an Iron's priest, wanders between villages. Find a priest, trade with him for a healing potion, and hear about the undead stirring beneath old graves.

quests.title: Ink and Parchment
quests.summary: Craft an inscription table, mix common ink, and copy a scroll for the library's records.

quests.title: Essence of the Arcane
quests.summary: Break down unwanted scrolls and enchanted gear into arcane essence, and gather twenty: the order's currency.

quests.title: A Book of One's Own
quests.summary: Bind a copper spellbook and inscribe your first spell into it, then cast it ten times at a target dummy.

quests.title: The Study
quests.summary: Every mage needs a study. Build one with wisewood bookshelves, a brazier, a pedestal for your book and a scroll rack.
quests.reward: Magic XP, wisewood planks, a book stack

quests.title: The Pyromancer's Tower
quests.summary: Orrin's old rival keeps a tower near the badlands. Find the Pyromancer Tower and ask its pyromancer to teach you, politely.

quests.title: Trial by Fire
quests.summary: The pyromancer only teaches those who can take a fireball. Duel him with spells (not swords) until he yields.
quests.reward: Magic XP, a pyromancer's hat, a fire rune

quests.title: School of Fire
quests.summary: Craft a fire rune, scribe firebolt onto a scroll, and set twenty mobs alight with it.

quests.title: The Apothecarist
quests.summary: Deep in the mangroves lives the Apothecarist, who trades potions for odd ingredients. Find the hut and trade her a stack of mangrove roots and spider eyes.

quests.title: The Poisoned Traveller
quests.summary: A courier staggers out of the swamp, poisoned, withered and slowing by the minute. Keep him alive with what the Apothecarist taught you: brew a cure for each ailment in turn, in an alchemist cauldron, before the next one sets in. The Apothecarist's reward is her own vessel, which drinks the poison out of you.

quests.title: Hags' Pantry
quests.summary: The Apothecarist won't go near the witches, but she wants their stock. Visit a witch hut and bring back a witch's redstone, glowstone and a bottle of her brew.

quests.title: The Lost Apprentice
quests.summary: Wren, Orrin's apprentice, ran off with three of his books. Track her to a wizard tower in the old forests, solve the warded door, and talk her into coming home.
quests.reward: Magic XP, Orrin's books, a wizard hat

quests.title: A Hundred Sparks
quests.summary: Cast a hundred spells, of any school. Orrin says it's how you learn where your mana runs out.
quests.reward: Magic XP, a mana upgrade orb

quests.title: The Bubbling Cauldron
quests.summary: Mix uncommon and rare ink in an alchemist cauldron, and brew a casters' tea for Orrin's long nights.

quests.title: The Arcane Anvil
quests.summary: Forge an arcane anvil and use it to merge two scrolls into a stronger one and add an upgrade orb to your armour.

quests.title: The Mithril Vein
quests.summary: Mine mithril deep in the deepslate, smelt it, and weave mithril cloth for a better spellbook.
quests.reward: Magic XP, Mining XP, a mithril spellbook binding

quests.title: The Cryomancer's Tower
quests.summary: High in the frozen peaks stands the Cryomancer's tower. Climb to it through the snow with the cold biting at you.

quests.title: Thaw the Cryomancer
quests.summary: The Cryomancer has gone cold in every way and attacks anyone who climbs his stairs. Defeat him using fire spells only.
quests.reward: Magic XP, a cryomancer's robe, an ice scroll

quests.title: School of Ice
quests.summary: Collect frozen bones and permafrost shards, craft an ice rune, and bind an ice spellbook.

quests.title: The Ice Spider Den
quests.summary: Follow a furled map to the Ice Spider den, kill its brood, and take one unbroken ice spider egg.

quests.title: A Cold Delicacy
quests.summary: Wren dares you to prepare and cook an ice spider egg, and then to serve it to Orrin without telling him what it is.
quests.reward: Magic XP, Cooking XP, Wren's grin

quests.title: The Impaled Icebreaker
quests.summary: A ship is skewered on an iceberg, its crew frozen solid. Climb aboard and bring the captain's sea chest back intact.
quests.reward: Magic XP, a whispers of ice disc

quests.title: Lightning in a Bottle
quests.summary: During a thunderstorm, catch three bottles of lightning before the storm passes, and craft a lightning rune.

quests.title: The Evoker Fort
quests.summary: Orrin's stolen tome, the Archevoker's logbook, is kept in the Evoker Fort. Scout it and report back the guard rotations to Orrin.

quests.title: The Unseen Thief
quests.summary: Get into the fort and take the logbook without any illager seeing you; caught once, you start again. Wren lends her trick for the first try (an invisibility elixir) and the scarf she 'borrowed' from Orrin years ago once you're out, because you've earned it.
quests.reward: Magic XP, the Scarf of Invisibility, the untranslated logbook

quests.title: In the Illagers' Hand
quests.summary: Translate the Archevoker's logbook with Orrin's help, decoding its cipher page by page. It names the catacombs where the dead are being raised.

quests.title: The Archevoker
quests.summary: The Archevoker summons fangs and vexes in the fort's great hall. Defeat him, if you want his robes.

quests.title: Five Schools
quests.summary: Show Orrin a scroll from each of five schools (fire, ice, lightning, nature and holy) and cast each once in front of him.

quests.title: Room for More
quests.summary: Bind a gold spellbook and add a spell-slot upgrade so it holds every school you know.

quests.title: The Graves Below
quests.summary: Sister Maren reads the logbook and goes pale. She leads you to an old graveyard where the stair down to the catacombs was found.

quests.title: The Catacombs
quests.summary: Descend into Iron's catacombs and clear its corridors of the risen dead.

quests.title: The Necromancers
quests.summary: Necromancers keep raising the dead faster than you can kill them. Hunt three and take the bone key one of them carries.

quests.title: Shards of the Phylactery
quests.summary: The bone key opens the catacombs' vaults, where pieces of a phylactery are hidden. Gather the shards for Maren before anyone else does.

quests.title: The Dead King
quests.summary: In the heart of the catacombs the Dead King (500 health) sits on his throne. Wake him and end his reign; Maren waits at the stair.
quests.reward: Magic XP, a dead king's lullaby disc

quests.title: The Forbidden School
quests.summary: Orrin forbids blood magic; Wren insists you should understand it to fight it. Craft a blood rune and cast a blood spell in secret.

quests.title: The Crimson Enchanter
quests.summary: An enchanting table grown from crimson wood stands somewhere in the Nether. Find it and enchant a book there with your own levels.

quests.title: The Ancient Map
quests.summary: The phylactery points to a fire-forged citadel in the Nether. Find or buy the furled maps to the Nether citadel and the ancient battleground.

quests.title: The Nether Citadel
quests.summary: Reach Iron's Nether citadel among the bastions, find the cinderous vault and read the inscriptions about the Flamebearer.

quests.title: The Ancient Battleground
quests.summary: Ancient Knights still keep watch on a Nether battlefield. Find it and defeat its Keepers, the citadel's armoured guardians.

quests.title: Cinder and Soul
quests.summary: Collect eight cinder essence from the citadel's guardians and the cinderous vaults; the forge needs a soul of fire.
quests.reward: Magic XP, a cinderous soul rune

quests.title: Pyrium
quests.summary: Forge pyrium ingots from cinder essence and netherite, the metal the Flamebearer's followers worked.
quests.reward: Magic XP, a pyrium staff haft

quests.title: Robes of Netherite
quests.summary: Upgrade your mage armour into a full netherite mage set.

quests.title: Eldritch Pages
quests.summary: Orrin says the void holds a school older than fire. Recover an eldritch manuscript from the End and learn one eldritch spell from it.

quests.title: Legendary Ink
quests.summary: Brew legendary ink in the alchemist cauldron and inscribe a legendary scroll of your own choosing.

quests.title: The Flamebearer's Trail
quests.summary: Bring Orrin, Maren and Wren together in the library tower with the citadel inscriptions and the phylactery shards; together they work out who the Flamebearer was, and why his echo still burns.

quests.title: The Statue of Tyros
quests.summary: Craft the Tyros Statue from pyrium and raise it on an altar far from Reece, the summoning place Orrin chose.

quests.title: Echo of Tyros
quests.summary: Wake the Echo of Tyros, First Flamebearer (1000 health, 15 armour), and lay the flame to rest, with Orrin, Maren and Wren watching from a safe distance.
quests.reward: Magic XP, the Flame Still Burns disc

quests.title: The Flamebearer's Codex
quests.summary: Orrin hands you his life's work to finish: bind a legendary spellbook with a page from every school you've mastered, and the order names you its next Archmage.
quests.reward: Magic XP, the Flamebearer's Codex (unique named legendary spellbook)
